_comment: Written by /studio init into .project-os/studio/registry.json. Thread ids are the durable identity of each party; parties are labels used in message routing. Authority never inverts: human > lead > director > specialists.
bridge_root: <absolute path on the project's existing sync layer, e.g. ~/sync/bridge/<project>/studio>

lead._comment: The lead owns the default branch and is the only merger. It is normally not driven by the bridge; its review is woken by the director's delivery (notify-hook) or by the session hint.

director.title: <project> studio
director._comment: A persistent thread on a provider that can spawn agents. Receives requests, decomposes, spawns/reuses specialists, consolidates, delivers. Never commits to the default branch.

specialists.title: <display name>
territory: <paths this specialist may change, if git:true>

activation._comment: event = the requester triggers the director when it sends; a delivery wakes the lead. NEVER a schedule: a polling heartbeat over a large-context director is the most expensive way ever devised to ask 'anything new?' (measured: 66% of a thread's spend bought 108 output tokens).
